description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing client transactions within the Fineract system. It includes endpoints for retrieving transaction lists, fetching individual transactions, and undoing transactions, supporting operations by client ID, external client ID, transaction ID, and external transaction ID. The class interacts with various services and serializers to facilitate security, data retrieval, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ClientTransactionsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing client transactions, providing endpoints for retrieving and undoing transactions by client and transaction identifiers.

methods.name: retrieveAllClientTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all transactions for a specified client, supporting pagination.

methods.name: retrieveClientTransaction
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific transaction for a client by transaction ID.

methods.name: undoClientTransaction
methods.description: Undoes a specific client transaction, identified by client and transaction IDs, or external identifiers.

methods.name: getClientTransaction
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a transaction and serialize the response.

methods.name: getAllClientTransactions
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve multiple client transactions with pagination, and serialize the result.

methods.name: undoTransaction
methods.description: Performs the undo operation for a transaction if the command parameter indicates so.

methods.name: resolveClientId
methods.description: Resolves a client ID from an external ID.

methods.name: resolveTransactionId
methods.description: Resolves a transaction ID from an external transaction ID.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if a command parameter matches a specific command value, ignoring case and whitespace.
